newsitem.title: USA: WMX Technologies names John Sanford CFO.
newsitem.headline: WMX Technologies names John Sanford CFO.

text.p: WMX Technologies Inc said Tuesday that it had named John Sanford as chief financial officer, succeeding James Koenig, who it said would become executive vice president.
Sanford had served previously as company treasurer and also as chief financial officer at WMX's Wheelabrator subsidiary, the company said.
The announcement came as the company reported a fourth quarter loss of $0.95 per share and announced a new business strategy that included the divestment of $1.5 billion in assets.
